name: Qadir, son of the eldest Qadir
description: The son who inherited the title, grew tyrannical and violent under Mishra's influence, unified the Fallaji and was killed by Ashnod at the Fall of Kroog.

description_citations.text: "Qadir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Qadir's son becomes the new Qadir and appoints Mishra his raki.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The mak fawa kills the Thaladin ambush, after which the tribe submits and the Suwwardi reign over the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: the mak fawa killed them all, saving every Suwwardi in the party

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an empire.
timeline.quote: the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an "empire"

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The peace summit collapses; the Qadir stabs the Yotian Warlord, Urza's automaton chokes the Qadir, and Mishra's Weakstone overloads the automaton.
timeline.quote: The Qadir drew his saber and stabbed the warlord in the chest, killing him.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod drains the Qadir's life with the Staff of Zegon, killing him, and Mishra becomes the last Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra himself became the last Qadir.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Drained his life with the Staff of Zegon.
relations.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill
